results.baseline_terminology: Original uncorrected APRIL/nodiscard44 continuation, not native synchronous DAPO.
results.eight_native_gradient_definition: Round aggregation of actor update norms; mean across inner updates, not the largest individual optimizer-update norm.
results.eight_stopping_condition: At round663 collect/pause stage: APRIL worker did not quiesce after native abort. Runtime error, not a normal budget completion; causation by gradient growth not established.
